title: Benchmarking zero-shot stance detection with FlanT5-XXL: Insights from training data, prompting, and decoding strategies into its near-SoTA performance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's baseline probability of outputting tokens with positive connotations (e.g., 'true', 'favor', 'positive') over negative ones by feeding context-free prompts (prompts without the actual input text) into the model. The authors also analyze unigram and bigram frequencies of these tokens in the pre-training and instruction-tuning data to identify the source of the bias.
